sources.snippet: An abliterated (refusal-removed) build of Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B — a 27B-parameter dense, hybrid-attention (Gated DeltaNet linear + full attention) native vision-language model with thinking control, tool-calling and an MTP head — quantized to MLX format for Apple Silicon.
